detail.longDescription:
TIL: If you run a MySQL docker container with a locally mounted data directory, it will inherit the case sensitivity of the HOST OS, not the one inside the container.  Yes, even on Mac.

... Which is why my DB name became case sensitive on GHA but wasn't on my local machine.

I hate technology.  Can we fix this BS before we destroy the world for bigger autocomplete?

#OSX #Containers #Docker #MySQL
